svg.title: Four condition plane
svg.desc: Condition reference template. Funding pressure increases to the right and risk appetite increases upward. Sunny is cheap money with willing investors; Cloudy is pricey money with willing investors; Stormy is cheap money with wary investors; Freezing is pricey money with wary investors. No current reading is plotted.

g.text: Condition reference template · quadrant meanings, without a reading
Money is cheap but investors are
Money is expensive and hard to
Quadrant reference; published calls also require persistence.

svg.title: Condition definition key
svg.desc: Reference template listing all four canonical conditions beside their weather glyphs and definitions; it states no current condition.

g.text: Reference template · four definitions, one vocabulary
Money is expensive and hard to raise.
Money is cheap but investors are wary.
Definitions describe money conditions; the weekly call supplies the action.

svg.title: Pause and resume ladder
svg.desc: Illustrative threshold template on a 0–100 score scale. Example funding pressure is 72; pause above 70 and resume below 60. These values demonstrate layout and are not current guidance.

g.text: Put the reading and both lines on one scale
Illustrative rule: pause above 70; resume below 60.
Illustrative example only; use your agreed lines and cited reading.

svg.title: Two thresholds with the same orientation
svg.desc: Illustrative paired threshold template on 0–100 scales. Funding pressure rises toward trouble: example 72, pause above 70, resume below 60. Risk appetite falls toward trouble: example 50, pause below 35, resume above 45. The lower scale is visibly reversed, so trouble sits on the right in both rows.

g.text: Keep trouble on the same side
Risk appetite · lower is tighter · scale reversed
Illustrative rules · pressure rises; appetite falls.
Both scales show 0–100; each keeps its own pause and resume lines.
Two thresholds with the same orientation

svg.title: Condition timeline template
svg.desc: Illustrative timeline template with six fictional equal-width weeks: Freezing, Cloudy, Cloudy, Stormy, Sunny and Sunny. Weather glyphs and words accompany every color. It is not an archive or a current forecast.

g.text: Illustrative example · a fictional sequence of six weeks
Fictional sequence to show the layout; no archived or forecast weeks.

svg.title: Signal trend with threshold
svg.desc: Illustrative trend template on a labeled 0–100 score domain with six fictional readings: 22, 31, 28, 49, 61 and 75. A dashed pause line sits at 70. This is not a measured time series or current guidance.

g.text: A reading against an agreed line
Illustrative example only; retain the domain and source when replacing it.

svg.title: Signals to decision path
svg.desc: Process template: read dated signals, name the conditions using the weekly call, choose an action calibrated to company constraints, set pause and resume lines, and share the cited artifact. It contains no current recommendation.

g.text: From signals to a shareable decision
Process template · use the existing brief and export flows
Revisit when an agreed line is crossed or the evidence changes.

svg.title: Pause and resume decision path
svg.desc: Blank bounded decision template with separate branches for the agreed pause condition and the resume condition. Pause uses the canonical pause glyph and line ink; resume uses the canonical play glyph and neutral ink. Placeholders contain no current guidance.

g.text: Agree the pause and the way back
A pause and a resume can have different conditions.

svg.title: Five area operating rules
svg.desc: Blank operating rule template covering the five canonical areas: Hiring, Roadmap, Fundraising, Spending and New bets. Each row has placeholders for action, pause line and resume line. No advice or current reading is prefilled.

g.text: Blank template · fill from the same cited brief
Replace placeholders with a cited reading before sharing.

svg.title: Decision change comparison
svg.desc: Blank decision delta template comparing a previous action and this week's action, with explicit placeholders for the reason and the reversal condition. It contains no current facts.

g.text: [The signal or company constraint that changed]
[The condition that would reverse this action]
Replace placeholders with a cited reading before sharing.

g.text: Keep the record date distinct from the time a source was checked.

Revisit when [the agreed reversal condition holds].
